framings.label: Playoff race and rankings implications
framings.description: Pieces treat each result mainly as a shift in the CFP and AP rankings, asking who is in, out or on the brink after upsets and the first committee release.

framings.label: Practical viewing guides and schedules
framings.description: Posts serve fans with live updates, schedules, TV information, GameDay locations and lists of the best games to watch.

framings.label: Upset alerts and weekend drama
framings.description: Previews and recaps build tension around ranked teams at risk, teams with no room for error, and top-ranked sides falling.

framings.label: Skepticism toward the ranking process
framings.description: Some items question the legitimacy of the committee and rankings, calling the show pointless, taking digs at the SEC and offering alternative rankings of how they should look.

framings.label: Cost and fan-experience burden
framings.description: An item focuses on the financial side of attending big games, such as steep hotel prices and ticket costs.
